parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Cursor page size. Omission defaults to 100 without cursor_token and reuses the cursor-bound limit with cursor_token.

parameters.name: cursor_token
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor bound to this route, caller, page size, and normalized filter set.

parameters.name: actor_user_id
parameters.description: Return only events attributed to this user actor.

parameters.name: action_code
parameters.description: Return only events with this exact action code.

parameters.name: target_kind
parameters.description: Return only deployment events with this target kind.

parameters.name: target_id
parameters.description: Return only events with this exact target identifier. target_kind is required when target_id is present.

parameters.name: occurred_at_lt
parameters.description: Exclusive UTC occurrence-time upper bound; it must be later than occurred_at_gte.

200.description: Deployment-scoped administrative-audit page ordered by occurred_at and audit_event_id descending.

400.description: A filter, range, page size, or cursor is invalid or does not match the normalized query.

401.description: A current authenticated session is required.

403.description: The authenticated caller is not a deployment administrator.

409.description: A credential-bootstrap bearer was presented to a route that accepts only session credentials.

500.description: An internal dependency or persistence operation failed.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Cursor page size. Omission defaults to 100 without cursor_token and reuses the cursor-bound limit with cursor_token.

parameters.name: cursor_token
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a prior page for the same normalized user-list query.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Optional list_search_v1 search text over user_id, email, and display_name. Omission or normalized-empty means no search predicate.

parameters.name: is_active
parameters.description: Optional exact lowercase boolean filter. Omission means no is_active predicate.

parameters.name: is_deployment_admin
parameters.description: Optional exact lowercase boolean filter. Omission means no is_deployment_admin predicate.
